CPI consensus +0.3% headline and +0.2% core m/m.[Capital Chronicle](https://x.com/Capitalnicle)[@Capitalnicle](https://x.com/Capitalnicle)[26s](https://x.com/Capitalnicle/status/2120015661133123666)• Positioning: EUR non-commercial net short 157,791 (COT as of 3 Nov, released 6 Nov), which covers above 1.1225 and 1.12348. • Reaction so far: accepted.[Capital Chronicle](https://x.com/Capitalnicle)[@Capitalnicle](https://x.com/Capitalnicle)[26s](https://x.com/Capitalnicle/status/2120015663519739955)• Why this zone: breakout zone 1.12270-1.12300 above the nearest resistance, the 9 Nov 15:00 ET H1 high of 1.12250 (same evidence and clock).[Capital Chronicle](https://x.com/Capitalnicle)[@Capitalnicle](https://x.com/Capitalnicle)[25s](https://x.com/Capitalnicle/status/2120015665981768027)• What confirms it: (1) the same-session USD fall across DXY, GBP/USD and NZDUSD in the native-intraday and cc164 H1 bars; (2) the -0.966 20-day DXY correlation in the EUR/USD quant card; (3) the crowded EUR short in COT as of 3 Nov.[Capital Chronicle](https://x.com/Capitalnicle)[@Capitalnicle](https://x.com/Capitalnicle)[24s](https://x.com/Capitalnicle/status/2120015668481548504)• Alternative mechanism: a hot core CPI that seals a December Fed hike and restores the NFP USD bid (DXY 102.032 to 102.36 on 6 Nov 08:00-09:00 ET).; Crowd trade (G05 5): chasing USD weakness into CPI, wrong on that print.[Capital Chronicle](https://x.com/Capitalnicle)[@Capitalnicle](https://x.com/Capitalnicle)[24s](https://x.com/Capitalnicle/status/2120015670742249531)Analysis, not financial advice.
